primitive.operation: For each head and latent column, sum key_row=0..191 in ascending order: kv_b_proj[head*448+key_row,latent_col] * query_nope[head,key_row].

admitted_codec.cardinality_policy: Exact cardinality is fail-closed because unchecked u8 codes cover precisely 0..255.

source_operand_requests_not_dram_claim.qualification: These are shader-source operand requests. Cache reuse is substantial and no DRAM-byte claim is made without counters.

correctness.reduction_order: One thread owns each output and visits key rows in strictly ascending order.

tiny_fixture.shape: 2 heads, 3 key rows, row stride 5, 8 latent columns

flagship_shape_fixture.shape: 64 heads, 192 key rows, row stride 448, 512 latent columns, D32/S1/sub32/card256/bits8

correctness.static_trace_name: registered and compiled; cannot fall into the generic Metal trace bucket

bits_gate_amendment.finding: The original direct-u8 encoder validated cardinality and geometry but did not receive the codec bit width as an argument, so its documented bits=8 admission was not mechanically closed.
bits_gate_amendment.correction: The encoder now requires pq_bits and rejects any value other than 8 before encoding a dispatch.
bits_gate_amendment.result: PASS including explicit bits=7 rejection with zero encoded dispatches

promotion_gate.reason: This proves only the K-side absorbed projection. Production activation requires the complete compact-attention chain and contention-free live evidence.
remaining_required_mechanisms: rank-ordered compact sparse attention over latent and shared RoPE cache
compact-cache production allocation and append wiring behind an explicit default-off path
contention-authorized live A/B and sustained 2K/8K/32K validation
